place_info.title: Terry Black's Barbecue
place_info.address: 1003 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78704, United States

reviews.snippet: You order cafeteria style. Despite the huge operation this is, they are efficient so you aren't standing in line for very long even when the line looks long. Staff are very friendly and helpful, especially to the wide eyed tourists. My brisket was moist and flavourful. It did not disappoint. Green beans were not overcooked and the Mac n cheese was nicely done without being overcooked either. I went around 5pm on a Tuesday and was able to order my food almost right away. I stood in line for 5 mins if that. The huge indoor seating area was full but the outdoor covered patio was pretty empty. When I left an hour later that was also starting to get full. So I would recommend trying to beat the dinner rush, even on a weekday. Parking is very limited. I took an uber but heard families complaining about trying to find parking in the lot.

reviews.snippet:
PERFECTO !!!
Absolutely outstanding barbecue!
Everything we tried was delicious. The quality of the meat, the flavor, and the overall experience were exactly what you would hope for when visiting one of Austin’s most famous BBQ spots.
My favorite was the pork ribs. The meat was tender, juicy, and the seasoning had penetrated deeply, making every bite incredibly flavorful. The brisket was also cooked to perfection—smoky, moist, and melt-in-your-mouth tender.
Despite the long line, the wait moved surprisingly quickly and was very well organized. The staff kept things running efficiently, so it never felt frustrating.
Another pleasant surprise was the value. Considering the quality of the food and the generous portions, the prices were very reasonable.
If you’re visiting Austin and want to experience authentic Texas barbecue at its best, Terry Black’s Barbecue is a must-visit. Every item we tried was excellent, and I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended!

reviews.snippet:
An outstanding experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible—perfectly smoked, incredibly juicy, and packed with flavor. You can truly taste the quality in every bite. The side dishes were just as delicious and complemented the barbecue perfectly, and the portions were very generous.

The service was exceptional. Every staff member was friendly, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel valued throughout our visit. The restaurant was clean, well-organized, and had a warm, authentic Texas barbecue atmosphere that made the experience even more enjoyable.

Even though the restaurant was busy, the ordering process was efficient, and the wait was absolutely worth it. It’s easy to see why this place has such a great reputation.

Without a doubt, this is one of the best barbecue restaurants I’ve ever visited. If you’re looking for authentic Texas barbecue, amazing food, outstanding service, and a great atmosphere, Terry Black’s Barbecue is a must-visit. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.snippet:
I travel for work from San Diego, and I was excited to come to Austin just to try authentic Texas BBQ. It definitely did not disappoint! The quality of the meat was incredible, these guys really know what they’re doing.

I loved the place, the atmosphere, and, of course, the food. I honestly don’t think it’s overpriced. High-quality BBQ like this takes premium meat and a tremendous amount of work behind the scenes, and it definitely shows.

Thanks, Austin, for such a warm welcome. Everyone was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain everything to me. Hopefully, I’ll be back someday!

reviews.snippet:
We visited Terry Black’s BBQ in Austin on a Sunday and arrived around 10:30 a.m. We found a parking spot easily and didn’t have to wait long in line, which was a great start.

We ordered brisket, turkey, and jalapeño cheddar sausage, along with green beans and creamed corn for sides. One of the staff members suggested we try the beef rib as well—and wow, what a fantastic recommendation that was! Everything was incredibly delicious. Every type of meat had its own unique flavor. In Hungarian, we would say it was “isteni finom”—divinely delicious—and that is no exaggeration.

The beef rib was absolutely amazing, easily the highlight of the meal and probably the best BBQ item I have ever tasted.

The restaurant itself is very nice, with plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors. But the best part of our visit was when one of the pitmasters took the time to show us how they smoke the meat. I’m actually a little embarrassed that I forgot to ask his name because he was incredibly kind and welcoming. He explained when they start smoking the meat, showed us the wood they use, described what the fire should look like when it’s just right, and even gave us a glimpse of the meat that was cooking at the time. It was fascinating and made the whole experience even more special.

Thank you very much to the entire team for the amazing food and hospitality. We had a wonderful time and will definitely be back if we are ever in Austin again!

reviews.snippet:
If you’re looking for authentic Texas barbecue, Terry Black’s absolutely lives up to the hype. From the moment you walk in, the smell of oak-smoked meat lets you know you’re in for something special.

The brisket is the star of the show perfectly smoked with a rich bark, incredible flavor, and so tender it practically melts in your mouth. The massive beef ribs are some of the best you’ll find anywhere, and the house-made sausage, pork ribs, and turkey are all outstanding. The sides aren’t an afterthought either the mac and cheese, creamed corn, potato salad, and baked beans are all excellent complements to the meat.

Despite often having a long line, the staff moves people through quickly, and the service is friendly and efficient. The portions are generous, and while it isn’t inexpensive, the quality of the food makes it well worth the price.

The atmosphere is exactly what you’d expect from legendary Texas barbecue casual, lively, and welcoming. Whether you’re a local or visiting Austin for the first time, Terry Black’s is a must-stop destination.

reviews.snippet:
This barbecue spot completely stole my heart. From the moment we walked in, the vibe was busy, lively, and full of that comforting energy you want in a great BBQ place—people laughing, plates piled high, and the smell of smoked goodness in the air.

The food? Absolutely delicious. Every bite of the barbecue was packed with flavor—perfectly cooked, tender, and just the right amount of smoky. You can tell they really know what they’re doing here. And the sides… honestly, don’t skip them. They were so yummy and just as memorable as the main dishes—each one felt like its own little star on the table.

Service was great too, which made everything flow so easily even with how busy it was. It never felt overwhelming, just exciting and full of life.

This place is easily one of my favorites now, and I already can’t wait to come back. If you’re looking for delicious barbecue, great energy, and a spot that just feels right, this is it.

reviews.snippet: When we first arrived, it looked great. The place looked like a cabin, with an outdoor grill where we could see meat being grilled. When we arrived, we were welcomed, however, not warmly. They welcomed us like they didn’t want to, but they had to. Anyway, the line was super quick, even though it was very common for people to wait hours just for the barbeque, but we went in line and waited, ~5 minutes? We ordered brisket, beef brisket, with sides of potato salad, coleslaw, and mac&cheese. The beef rib was amazing, it was thick, juicy, and fell off the bone. It was sad they didn’t have barbeque sauce, until we were done and saw barbeque sauce next to us. The ribs really blinded me, so I didn’t bother looking around. Maybe if the lines had been longer, I would’ve looked around and seen it 😂. Anyway, a bad part about the ribs was how the crust of the ribs was too salty and hard, later on, I kearnt they actually gave us a part of the ribs they weren't supposed to serve. This was very dissapointing. Moving on to the briskets, it was delicious. It was extremely tender and juicy. The potato salad was amazing, but every potato salad I had in a barbeque place in Texas was amazing, so nothing else to say. I waited in line again to buy soda, and we bought a classic Coca-Cola and a Frostie Blue Cream Soda. The Coco Cola was amazing, but the cream soda was too sweet, with even more sugar than the Coco Cola! I really wish they would offer a wider selection of drinks, like Fanta or Sprite! I was going to give a rating of 2 stars, but I thought about the whole journey. We didn’t have a line, the food was delicious and juicy. With the only problem being how expensive it was, I have no other complaints. I believe the bill was ~$200 for beef brisket and a half pound brisket with 3 sides and 2 drinks. That sounds overkill, with people being able to buy ~10 fast food combos with that money, but it was indeed a great experience! I strongly suggest going here. It is much more delicious than some other barbeque places in Houston, and frankly, a much better place to go in Austin. Franklin’s BBQ might be better, but we came 1 hour before they opened, and I guarantee you there were around 50 people already in line. Overall, I would recommend this place. However, they did not exceed my expectations, and I was slightly disappointed.
